title: Bellarmine
summary: Raleigh names Bellarmine in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Bellarmine, the Cardinall, who thinkes that Manasses was taken in the fifteenth yeere of his raigne, and who placeth the storie of Iudith in this age. Raleigh doth not follow him. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVII, §. III, sig. 364a–364b
